name: rtl-fix
description: Displays Hebrew/Arabic (RTL) text correctly in your messages and Claude's replies

mode.title: RTL mode
mode.description: auto: pick by terminal (terminal for macOS Terminal, visual for others). visual: reorder RTL text for terminals that draw left to right (iTerm2 with its own RTL support off). terminal: pre-compensate for terminals that run their own bidi with a left-to-right base (macOS Terminal). marks: add Unicode direction marks.
